response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff-level engineer with strong backend and distributed systems expertise. However, he completely lacks the executive leadership experience, team-scaling track record (10 to 30+ engineers), and deep production experience operating multi-agent AI systems in regulated financial environments required for this CTO role. His career trajectory is firmly aligned with an Individual Contributor path rather than strategic organizational leadership.
strengths: Over 15 years of hands-on engineering experience, including designing high-throughput microservices and event-driven architectures.
Demonstrated passion for software craftsmanship, TDD, and mentoring through workshops and open-source contributions.
Some relevant exposure to fintech at RIDE Capital and recent hands-on work with AI-agent infrastructure.
concerns: Zero evidence of executive-level engineering leadership or experience scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+ people.
Lacks deep, multi-year production experience operating complex multi-agent AI systems in high-stakes environments.
Career trajectory and accomplishments are firmly on the Individual Contributor (IC) track rather than organizational management.
